_about: Hand fixes for challoner.py. 'words': whole-word replacements everywhere. 'replace': [chapter 'book.chapter', old text, new text]; old matches exactly once in that chapter; 're:' starts a regular expression; U+2029 in new text splits the paragraph and U+2063 around a text makes it a heading. 'titles' and 'notes' override a chapter's title or add its note.
